description: Sum nutrients over a list of TACO foods (ids from search_food). Each item has either grams or a household_measure with quantity (e.g. "colher de sopa" x 2, covered foods only; see convert_household_measure). Totals are lower bounds when an item has no data for a nutrient: the response says which. Defaults to energy, protein, fat, carbohydrate, fiber and sodium.

items.description: Foods in the meal. The same food may appear more than once.

food_id.description: TACO food number, as returned by search_food.

grams.description: Quantity of this food in grams of edible portion, as eaten (cooked weight for cooked foods). Give this or household_measure, not both.

household_measure.description: Household measure instead of grams, e.g. "colher de sopa", "unidade", "fatia", "concha". Only for foods with curated measures.

quantity.description: How many of household_measure (default 1; may be fractional). Not used with grams.

nutrients.description: Nutrient keys to total. Omit for energy, protein, fat, carbohydrate, fiber and sodium.

name: calc_meal

complete.description: True when every requested nutrient has data for every item (no total is a lower bound).

household_source.description: Citation for the household measure weights; set when any item used one.

items.description: The meal items in the order received.

additionalProperties.description: A number in the nutrient unit; {"trace":true} when the table reports a trace (Tr, below the quantification limit); null when the TACO table publishes no value (not analyzed, not applicable or under re-evaluation). Never read null or trace as 0.

amounts.description: Amount of each requested nutrient in this item, keyed by nutrient key.

grams.description: Quantity of this item, in grams of edible portion.

household.description: Set when the item was given as a household measure and converted to grams.

grams_per_measure.description: Weight of one measure in grams.

source_description.description: Description of the POF row the weight comes from.

name.description: Food name exactly as in the TACO table.

totals.description: One entry per requested nutrient, in table order.

is_lower_bound.description: True when at least one item has no value in the TACO table for this nutrient: the real total is higher than this number.

not_analyzed_in.description: Names of the items with no value in the TACO table for this nutrient.

total.description: Sum over the items that have data. null when no item has data; {"trace":true} when every item is trace.

trace_in.description: Names of the items reported as trace (Tr) for this nutrient; they add a tiny, unquantified amount.

title: Calculate the nutrients of a meal
